_comment: Every file submitted to the Pangram API must be listed here by path.
That is the consent control: nothing is sent that was not deliberately
named. Copy to calibration/manifest.json (gitignored) and edit.
arm 'human' must be prose that is confidently pre-LLM (added to git
before ~2022) or confidently hand-written. Recent drafts may have had
AI assistance and would contaminate the baseline.
NEVER list: referee reports, unpublished coauthored work without the
coauthors' agreement, anything embargoed or confidential.
